title: Deproi server configuration
description: /etc/deproi/<name>.json — owned by root, not writable by others. Docs: https://github.com/rodrigo-pasini/deproi/blob/main/docs/configuration.md

argv.description: A command as a list of arguments, never a shell string.

insidePath.description: A path relative to the checkout, without '..'.

name.description: Shown in the log and the summary.

command.description: Runs with `docker compose run --rm --no-deps <service>` on the NEW image.

service.description: Compose service whose image runs the hook. Default: compose.web_service.

timeout.description: Seconds. Default: timeouts.hook (migrate hooks share timeouts.migrations).

on_failure.description: fail → FAILED_NO_CHANGE; refuse → REFUSED; warn → log and continue. Defaults: pre_migrate/migrate fail, post_migrate/post_deploy warn (post_deploy only accepts warn).

name.description: Must match the installed command: /usr/local/sbin/deproi-<name> reads /etc/deproi/<name>.json.

language.description: Language of the messages for the operator. Default en.

path.description: The git checkout on the server.

owner.description: User that owns the checkout; git runs as this user.

project.description: Compose project name, always passed explicitly.

env_file.description: Versioned env file. When set, its COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME must equal compose.project (checked before the checkout moves).

secrets_file.description: Untracked env file with secrets. Absolute (recommended, e.g. /etc/deproi/<name>.secrets.env) or relative to the checkout.

service_suffix.description: Every service of the definition must end with it (fence between environments on one server).

web_service.description: The service whose health check decides success or rollback.

image.description: Image repository, without tag. Built services must use image: <image>:${DEPROI_TAG}.

tag_variables.description: Variables set to the commit tag for Compose interpolation. Default ["DEPROI_TAG"].

url.description: Public URL, shown in the success message and default host for the Cloudflare purge.

script_path.description: Where the project versions deproi.py. Default deploy/deproi.py.

docs.description: Link shown in failure messages (your plan B). Default: Deproi's operations guide.

migrations.description: Shared by all migrate hooks. Default 2400.

health.description: Wait for the web service to be healthy. Default 240.

pull.description: Pass --pull to the build. Default false.

min_free_disk_gb.description: Minimum free space for Docker. Default 5.

pre_migrate.description: Checks with the new image before any change (e.g. framework deploy checks).

post_migrate.description: After migrations, before recreating (e.g. sync feature flags).

post_deploy.description: Detached, after the new version is live. Never changes the outcome.

protected_services.description: Services that must not be recreated in the middle of their work.

busy_check.description: Runs with docker exec. Exit 0 = idle, 1 = busy, anything else = no answer (treated as busy).

quiesce.description: Optional: stop taking new work before recreating (busy_check runs again after it).

resume.description: Optional: undo quiesce when the service is not recreated.

integrations.description: All optional. Tokens live in root-only (0600) files, never in this JSON.

credentials_file.description: Env file with BETTERSTACK_UPTIME_TOKEN and/or BETTERSTACK_ERRORS_TOKEN.

monitors.description: Uptime monitor ids that get a grace period while services are recreated.

credentials_file.description: Env file with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (Zone → Cache Purge).
